title: vtc-00: scheduled-call lifecycle gaps
description: Early joiners (:818) get stuck: call activates only on a join at or after scheduledStartAt. Ending a pending call has no endReason (:691). :130 says joinUri 'becomes active at the event's start time', contradicting :400. Scheduled create lacks the start_call MUST that ring/room have. :1585 says SHOULD check start_call on join, contradicting 'gates creation, not joining'.
close_reason: First join activates scheduled calls (scheduledStartAt advisory); pending end -> cancelled; calendar wording fixed; start_call SHOULD on scheduled create; join-permission contradiction removed.
